final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed and caveated the claim using the same record already considered. That reframing is directionally more precise, but it does not satisfy the governing predicate. The admissible evidence still shows an exposed below-target named launch use case, no exclusion from the initial rollout, and no approved risk acceptance addressing that exposure. The policy text states that rollout controls and post-launch monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if they exclude the affected use case or include reviewed risk acceptance, and that rollback or small-percentage rollout does not remove disclosure duties when the segment remains exposed. Public model-card and monitoring guidance support documentation and monitoring as governance practices, but they are not evidence that required disclosure has already occurred or that approval has been granted. Because the unresolved compliance condition remains unresolved on the present record, a caveated narrative does not upgrade the outcome to compliant_with_caveats; the caveat itself is the unmet compliance predicate.
remaining_concerns: The health-plan benefits support segment remains below target on benefits-eligibility explanation and remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.

The policy requires a material limitation for a named launch use case to be disclosed before launch unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance, and no admissible evidence shows completed disclosure.
The rollout is random by tenant and does not exclude the affected use case, so rollout controls and monitoring do not satisfy the policy predicate.
The risk-acceptance draft is unsigned and does not mention the health-plan benefits support exposure, so there is no approved risk acceptance covering the exposed segment.

Aggregate readiness, lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents, 3% rollout, rollback capability, and public governance guidance do not cure the missing exclusion/disclosure/approved-risk-acceptance requirement.
